Maya (CS): Heads-up — TailorFlow's onboarding cluster saw median prompt latency climb ~18% week-over-week after yesterday's traffic spike. They're flagged as a mid-funnel renewal risk (Q2). Thinking we should propose a low-risk perf play: compact model canary + routing tweak + prefix cache bump. :eyes:

Arjun (SRE): Agreed. Quick plan: 1) Canary 5% -> redwood-compact-v2-int8 2) Route short prompts (<256 tokens) to compact-v2, long to standard 3) Increase prefix cache TTL for recurring prompts. Expect ~30-40% token latency reduction on short paths.

Leah (Solutions): Quick note on quality: our evals show compact-v2-int8 drops entail ~0.6-0.9% on our TailorFlow prompt set (mostly hallucination-free). Recommend staged eval run and a scorer check before 10% traffic. Also recommend enabling model fallback on top-k degens. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Arjun (SRE): I'll kick off the canary config. Sample routing snippet to apply in routes policy (will validate in staging):

```yaml
policies:
  - name: tailorflow-shortroute
    match: request.tokens <= 256
    rollout:
      - model: redwood-compact-v2-int8
        percent: 5
      - model: redwood-standard-v1
        percent: 95
    fallback: redwood-standard-v1
    cache:
      prefix_ttl: 600s
```

Arjun (SRE): Also adding `quality-guard` hook: fail canary if eval BLEU drops >1.5% or latency SLO not met for 3 consecutive 5m windows.

Priya (AM): Can we get an ETA to present this to TailorFlow this week? Renewal convo scheduled next Thurs — they'd like cost-saving numbers. If compact path is ~25% cheaper on tokens and latency improves, that's a strong retention play.

Maya (CS): I'll book a 30m sync with TailorFlow for Wed 11am PT. Action items: Arjun -> staging canary + eval run (by Tue EOD), Leah -> summarize eval deltas and suggested fallbacks, Priya -> prepare cost delta slide. I'll capture customer expectations on the call. :calendar:

ci-bot: Canary job started (#canary-tailorflow-689912) — running eval suite against redwood-compact-v2-int8. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/689912

Arjun (SRE): Canary run looks clean so far (first 30m): latency median -32%, p95 -18%, eval BLEU -0.7%. Moving to 10% if no regressions in next 2h.

Leah (Solutions): I'll prep a single-slide summary with the BLEU/ROUGE deltas and recommended mitigation (temperature adjust + conservative decoding) in case customer flags quality.

Maya (CS): Thanks — bringing this to TailorFlow Wed. If they push back on any quality blip, we keep fallback and can revert routing quickly. Will post notes after the call. :rocket:
